pictures.scene: De Wet, Christ Blessing the Children — Christ sits on the step in a worn white robe with His hand laid on His own breast, His head bent down toward the smallest of them, and the children are brought up to Him from every side, a girl in a yellow dress kneeling at His knee with her hands together, a boy in a red cap sitting on the flagstones with his back to us, mothers crouching in the dust holding babies out toward Him, while the older men stand back in the dark of the doorway and watch, jesus said to his disciples, it is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come, it would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble, …
pictures.name: pd_dewet_christus_zegent_kinderen

pictures.scene: Reni, The Penitent Saint Peter — the old apostle is seen close to, half turned away, the blue mantle fallen off one shoulder and a thin gold halo cut by the dark behind him, his two big worn hands locked together over the key and pressed against his chest, his mouth open and his eyes lifted sideways and up in the middle of saying something he can hardly get out, watch yourselves, if your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him, even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, i repent, you must forgive him, …
pictures.name: pd_guido_reni_the_penitent_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Olive Trees — old olives stand in a terraced orchard with their trunks bent and doubled over like wrung rope, the grey and green leaves laid on in short curved strokes against a thick white sky, and the whole slope of ground underneath worked in ribbons of orange, yellow and blue that run away downhill, every inch of the canvas moving at once, the apostles said to the lord, increase our faith, and the lord answered, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, be uprooted and planted in the sea, and it will obey you, …
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_olive_trees

pictures.scene: Van Konijnenburg, Ploughing — a labourer in a dark smock and leggings walks up the stony headland with his arms folded over the handles of the plough and his head down, pushing one boot ahead of the other through the clods, and beside him the great red-brown ox leans into the chain with its hooves set among the broken stones, the pale field running away behind them to a low line of trees, which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, come at once and sit down to eat, …
pictures.name: pd_konijnenburg_ploegen

pictures.scene: Larsson, The Kitchen — a tall girl in a blue striped pinafore stands bent over the washing-up at the sink, her plait hanging forward over her red sleeve and her face turned down to the work without a thought of being watched, the clean plates stacked draining on the board beside the window and a pot plant on the sill behind them, while a very small sister in a flowered dress and a dark bonnet stands close against her skirts holding on to the pail, does he thank the servant because he did what he was told, so you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, we are unworthy servants, we have only done our duty, …
pictures.name: pd_larsson_koket

pictures.scene: Corot, The Road — a single traveller in a dark cloak with a bundle under the arm walks away from us down the long pale chalk road as it dips between the trees and climbs again, a tall mass of green boughs hanging down the whole right-hand side and a lighter tree with white cottage walls below it on the left, the country opening out far ahead into a low hazy plain under a wide sky of broken cloud, while jesus was on his way to jerusalem, he was passing between samaria and galilee, as he entered one of the villages, he was met by ten lepers, they stood at a distance, …
pictures.name: pd_corot_road

pictures.scene: Victors, Hannah Praying in the Temple — an old woman in a fur-lined gown and a great pleated red hat is seen close to in the dark of the temple, her two worn hands locked together under her chin and her head tipped back so that her eyes look up and away past us, her mouth open in the middle of the words she is saying out loud, a pale stone column and the shadowed screen of the sanctuary standing behind her shoulders, and raised their voices, shouting, jesus, master, have mercy on us, when jesus saw them, he said, go, show yourselves to the priests, and as they were on their way, they were cleansed, …
pictures.name: pd_victors_hanna_biddend_in_de_tempel

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Simeon's Song of Praise — in the brown dark of the great temple one shaft of light falls on the old man kneeling in a gold brocade mantle with the newborn child held up on his two hands, his white beard lifted and his face turned up into the light as he says the words out loud, the young mother kneeling beside him in blue with her hands crossed on her breast, the crowd on the temple steps behind them sunk in shadow and only the nearest heads catching the light, when one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising god in a loud voice, he fell facedown at jesus' feet in thanksgiving to him, and he was a samaritan, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_simeons_song_of_praise

pictures.scene: Duccio, Christ and the Samaritan Woman — Christ sits barefoot on the rim of the stone well in a blue mantle over a red robe, one hand laid on the kerb and the other lifted toward her as He speaks, and the Samaritan woman stands on the far side with the big clay jar balanced on her veiled head, her bucket and rope hanging from her left hand and her right hand raised flat in the middle of answering Him back, the whole panel laid on a worn gold ground, were not all ten cleansed, jesus asked, where then are the other nine, was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to god, …
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christ_and_the_samaritan_woman

pictures.scene: Memling, Christ Giving His Blessing — Christ is painted close and straight on against a plain dark ground, the long brown hair falling either side of a quiet unmarked face, the eyes looking directly out at whoever stands in front of the panel, thin ruled gold rays coming off the head instead of a ring, and the right hand lifted at the bottom of the picture with two fingers raised in blessing over a dark red robe, then jesus said to him, rise and go, your faith has made you well, when asked by the pharisees when the kingdom of god would come, jesus replied, the kingdom of god will not come with observable signs, …
pictures.name: pd_memling_christ_giving_his_blessing

pictures.scene: Brueghel, The Sermon on the Mount — under a wall of great summer trees a crowd of hundreds is packed across the whole floor of the wood, townsmen in black hats and ruffs, women in white caps with babies on their arms, children and a small dog in the front corner, a girl in a yellow gown sitting on the ground with her back to us, and far back in the middle of them all a single small figure in pale robes with a thin halo stands raised a little above the heads and speaks, nor will people say, look, here it is, or there it is, for you see, the kingdom of god is in your midst, then he said to the disciples, the time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the son of man, but you will not see it, …
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_bergrede

pictures.scene: Francisque Millet, Mountain Landscape with Lightning — a single crooked bolt comes down out of a black rolling storm and burns a bright gold line all the way from the torn cloud to the hills, the rain hanging in grey curtains across the far valley, the whole wide country below sunk in green-black shadow with a walled town, a bridge and a river in it, and on the ridge in the near corner two travellers sit on a rock, one of them throwing an arm up at the sky, for just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the son of man in his day, …
pictures.name: pd_francisque_millet_berglandschap_met_bliksem

pictures.scene: Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — Christ sits alone on a low rock in a stony grey desert at first light, barefoot, wrapped in a dark worn mantle over a dull red robe, His elbows on His knees and His two hands clenched together in front of Him, His head down and His eyes fixed on nothing while the cold pink dawn comes up along the horizon behind Him and the broken stones run away in every direction, but first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation, …
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Peasant Wedding — the barn is packed for the wedding feast, the bride sitting still under a green cloth hung on the wall with a paper crown over her head and her hands folded while everybody else eats, two servers carrying bowls of porridge in on an unhinged door for a tray, one of them in a blue jerkin and a red cap bent under the weight of it, a man at the end of the table reaching across to hand the dishes down, and the guests on the benches drinking and spooning and talking all at once, people were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day noah entered the ark, then the flood came and destroyed them all, …
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_peasant_wedding

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — the whole sky above the plain is one standing sheet of fire, white hot at its heart and curling over at the top into red-black smoke, with burning matter falling out of it in streaks onto the far city, the near town lying black and still under its walls in the shadow below, and out on the dark ridge at the right two tiny pale figures hurrying away from it along the road, but on the day lot left sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all, it will be just like that on the day the son of man is revealed, …
pictures.name: pd_john_martin_the_destruction_of_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Reni, Lot Leaving Sodom — the old man in a heavy red mantle is caught mid-step on his way out of the city, his bald head turned down and back over his shoulder and one hand open as though he were still arguing, and his daughter in a gold gown walks close at his side with a bundle of cloth gathered up in her arms, her face in profile and her lips parted as she speaks to him, the two of them lit out of a flat brown dark that shows nothing of what they are leaving, on that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions, likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind, remember lot's wife, …
pictures.name: pd_reni_lot_leaving_sodom

pictures.scene: Anker, Sleeping Boy in the Hay — a farm boy has dropped flat on his back in the cut grass against the wall of a wooden barn and gone straight to sleep, his arms flung out either side of him, his mouth a little open and his eyes shut, a brown waistcoat open over a white shirt and blue trousers worked up above one bare brown foot, his straw hat lying where it fell beside his shoulder, i tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed, one will be taken and the other left, …
pictures.name: pd_anker_slaap

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Wheatfield with Crows — a field of ripe wheat is laid on in thick yellow strokes that run every way at once, a rutted track of brown and green cutting up through the middle of it and dividing into two, a heavy blue-black sky pressing down from above with one pale cloud torn open in it, and a scatter of black crows flying up low out of the corn toward the far edge of the field, two women will be grinding grain together, one will be taken and the other left, where, lord, they asked, jesus answered, wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather, …
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_wheatfield_with_crows

lines.text: Jesus said to His disciples, It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, I repent, you must forgive him.
The apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith!
And the Lord answered, If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, Be uprooted and planted in the sea, and it will obey you.
Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, Come at once and sit down to eat?
Instead, won't he tell him, Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink?
Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.
While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance
and raised their voices, shouting, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!
When Jesus saw them, He said, Go, show yourselves to the priests. And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
He fell facedown at Jesus' feet in thanksgiving to Him, and he was a Samaritan.
Were not all ten cleansed? Jesus asked. Where then are the other nine?
Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?
Then Jesus said to him, Rise and go; your faith has made you well!
When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
Nor will people say, Look, here it is, or There it is. For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.
Then He said to the disciples, The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
People will tell you, Look, there He is! or Look, here He is! Do not go out or chase after them.
For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
Remember Lot's wife!
Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: One will be taken and the other left.
Two women will be grinding grain together: One will be taken and the other left.
Where, Lord? they asked. Jesus answered, Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
